title: Series 基础与按标签对齐（引入缺失就升 dtype）
expected_output:
pandas 3.0.6
s =
a    1
b    2
c    3
dtype: int64
dtype = int64 | index.name = None | values 类型 = ndarray
--- 索引对齐（最容易踩的坑）---
x = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
y = {'b': 10, 'c': 20}
x + y 会先按标签取并集再对齐 :
a     NaN
b    12.0
c     NaN
dtype: float64
结果 dtype = float64 （出现缺失值后 int 升为 float）
--- 换成 ndarray 就不对齐，按位置相加 ---
x + np.array([100, 100]) = {'a': 101, 'b': 102}
--- reindex 显式对齐 ---
x.reindex(['a','b','c']) = {'a': 1.0, 'b': 2.0, 'c': nan}
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
print("pandas", pd.__version__)
s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3], index=["a", "b", "c"])
print("s =")
print(s)
print("dtype =", s.dtype, "| index.name =", s.index.name, "| values 类型 =", type(s.values).__name__)
print("--- 索引对齐（最容易踩的坑）---")
x = pd.Series([1, 2], index=["a", "b"])
y = pd.Series([10, 20], index=["b", "c"])
print("x =", x.to_dict())
print("y =", y.to_dict())
print("x + y 会先按标签取并集再对齐 :")
print(x + y)
print("结果 dtype =", (x + y).dtype, "（出现缺失值后 int 升为 float）")
print("--- 换成 ndarray 就不对齐，按位置相加 ---")
print("x + np.array([100, 100]) =", (x + np.array([100, 100])).to_dict())
print("--- reindex 显式对齐 ---")
print("x.reindex(['a','b','c']) =", x.reindex(["a", "b", "c"]).to_dict())
